excerpt: J221 Intro to Visualizing Data This is a course in finding and telling visual stories from data. We will cover fundamental principles of data analysis and visual presentation, chart types and when to use them, and how to acquire, process and “interview” data. We will make interactive and static charts and maps using free software. We will be making graphics by writing code, as well as using point-and-click software. The emphasis is on gaining practical skills that students can apply in a newsroom setting.
